changelog: Turbo speed multipliers (1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x) and re-tuned airport distances for fast-paced FiveM sessions.
Fixed patience penalty for aircraft authorized and flying their final approach.
Player-driven mode switcher: choose between Simple mode and Expert mode on the fly from the top bar.
Expert mode bonus: +50% boost on score, career XP, and salary payout when playing in Expert mode.
3D DUI computer workstation: placing the post spawns an in-game dual-monitor computer prop with live 3D DUI radar and eye-level camera zoom.
Interactive in-game 3D raycast runway placement tool in /conf_acn_airtraffic.
Approach controls in Simple mode: abort approach, go-around, or hold at any time.
Enhanced visual interface with airline brand badges (Air France, British Airways, Lufthansa, Emirates, etc.).
